tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Greening of Urban Space Under Fly Over Space /Junction/Circles /Islands

itemList.description: Site Cleaning:  Removal of dried leaves, solid waste and cleaning of the area (Horticulture Division BBMP SR 2019-20 Page No.1 Item No-1)

Supplying of  Red Soil (New Earth Filling)
Supply of Good Quality Red Soil for Gardening and Growing of Plants, Shrubs, Etc., Including the % weightage given to BWCC Area.

Shrubs in Groups
Developing the area for shrubs by digging to a depth of 0.45m, filling 50% with sand [0,0375 Cum], FYM [0.075 Cum], Red earth [0.21], [I.e. in the proportion of 1:2:3] and planting with well established plants (8 plants per sq mtr) exclusive of cost of plants and inclusive of ingredients (Horticulture Division BBMP SR 2019-20 Page No.1 Item No-4(a)
Cost of the Plant (8 Plants per Sqm) including Transportation and  Handling Charges                         (Horticulture Division BBMP SR 2019-20 Page No.1 Item No-4(b)
Cement Pots of Size 2 x 2x 1 1/2  Feet with 6mm Steel Fabrication, Teracotta Painting, Handling and Transportation to the site.

Specimen plants    
Digging pits size 0.75m x 0.75m x 0.75 filling up to 50% the pits with top excavated soil and remaining 50% with sand, Fym, Red earth (0,021 Cum) (i.e. in the proportion of 1:2:3) and planting of  Ficus Benjamina Panda/ Radermachera Sinica (china doll) (90cm - 150cmm ht)     Ficus traingularis Including cost of plant, materials, transporation and handling & planting Cost)   (Horticulture Division BBMP SR 2019-20 Page No.6  Item No-16 (9)

Digging pits size 0.75m x 0.75m x 0.75 filling up to 50% the pits with top excavated soil and remaining 50% with sand, Fym, Red earth (0,021 Cum) (i.e. in the proportion of 1:2:3) and planting of Rapis Excelsa ( 90cm - 1200cm ht)  Including cost of plant, materials, transporation and handling & planting Cost) (Horticulture Division BBMP SR 2019-20 Page No.5 Item No-16 (7)

Digging pits size 0.75m x 0.75m x 0.75 filling up to 50% the pits with top excavated soil and remaining 50% with sand, Fym, Red earth (0,021 Cum) (i.e. in the proportion of 1:2:3) and planting of Plumeria singaporensis dwarf (60 to 90cm)Including cost of plant, materials, transporation and handling & planting Cost)  (Horticulture Division BBMP SR 2019-20 Page No.8  Item No-16 (28)

Digging pits size 0.75m x 0.75m x 0.75 filling up to 50% the pits with top excavated soil and remaining 50% with sand, Fym, Red earth (0,021 Cum) (i.e. in the proportion of 1:2:3) and planting of Woodyetia Bifurcata (Fox Tail Palm-120-150cm height) Including cost of plant, materials, transporation and handling & planting Cost)  (Horticulture Division BBMP SR 2019-20 Page No.7  Item No-16 (15)

Digging pits size 0.75m x 0.75m x 0.75 filling up to 50% the pits with top excavated soil and remaining 50% with sand, Fym, Red earth (0,021 Cum) (i.e. in the proportion of 1:2:3) and planting of syzygium campanulatum (120cm - 150cm ht) Including cost of plant, materials, transporation and handling & planting Cost)  (Horticulture Division BBMP SR 2019-20 Page No.8  Item No-16 (22)

Digging pits size 0.75m x 0.75m x 0.75 filling up to 50% the pits with top excavated soil and remaining 50% with sand, Fym, Red earth (0,021 Cum) (i.e. in the proportion of 1:2:3) and planting of philodendron xanadusilver (45-60) Including cost of plant, materials, transporation and handling & planting Cost)  (Horticulture Division BBMP SR 2019-20 Page No.8 Item No-16 (24)

Digging pits size 0.75m x 0.75m x 0.75 filling up to 50% the pits with top excavated soil and remaining 50% with sand, Fym, Red earth (0,021 Cum) (i.e. in the proportion of 1:2:3) and planting of Brassaia actinophylla (150 cmm -210 cm Including cost of plant, materials, transporation and handling & planting Cost)  (Horticulture Division BBMP SR 2019-20 Page No.8 Item No-16 (25)
